basics.name: Chris Olsen
basics.summary: With over 15 years of experience in web development and architecture, I bring a proven ability to build robust, scalable, and user-friendly solutions. I’ve led projects end-to-end, bridging the gap between business goals and technical execution, and consistently delivering high-performance applications. Whether writing clean code, designing system architecture, or guiding teams, I focus on creating solutions that are efficient, maintainable, and aligned with long-term goals. I bring both technical depth and strategic insight to every project.
